compiled_state.title: [brainstorm-orchestrator]: scrutiny pipeline offered as user-skippable option -> HARD-GATE bypass surface exposed during epic creation
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview
During /dso:brainstorm execution converting bug 7883-a502 into an epic, the orchestrator presented a 3-option choice that included 'Skip scrutiny pipeline, create epic minimally' as a path forward. The user immediately rejected this and called out that scrutiny-skip must never be offered as an option.

## Expected Behavior
When creating a new epic via /dso:brainstorm, the canonical scrutiny pipeline (Red Team + Blue Team + 3 fidelity reviewers + approval gate per skills/shared/workflows/epic-scrutiny-pipeline.md) is non-negotiable. The brainstorm SKILL.md already encodes this via HARD-GATE 'SUBSTITUTIONS PROHIBITED'. The orchestrator should never present the user with a skip option, even framed as a save-time/save-context tradeoff. The only valid exception is placeholder epics that are explicitly scoped as requiring a future brainstorm session of their own (e.g., scrutiny:pending stub epics created during preplanning split).

## Actual Behavior
Orchestrator emitted an AskUserQuestion containing option (c): 'Skip scrutiny pipeline, create epic minimally — Create the epic with the drafted spec, link to 5efb-06ea as depends_on, write Planning Intelligence Log marking scrutiny as orchestrator-confirmed only, tag and close. Faster but the brainstorm:complete tag may be rejected by the validator.' The framing acknowledged the gate but presented it as a user-choice tradeoff, exposing a bypass surface the brainstorm SKILL.md HARD-GATE explicitly prohibits.

## Classification (llm-behavioral)
Skill file: plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md
Behavioral signal: orchestrator surfaced an option that contradicts the canonical pipeline HARD-GATE. The skill text itself does not authorize the option; the orchestrator constructed it. Suggests the existing HARD-GATE wording (which prohibits substitutions in the workflow execution path) does not explicitly cover the orchestrator presenting substitutions as user-facing choices. Strengthening could be: HARD-GATE addendum 'NEVER offer the user a choice that includes skipping the scrutiny pipeline. The pipeline is non-optional regardless of session context, time pressure, or context budget. The only valid scrutiny-skip is the placeholder-epic exception: when the epic is explicitly scoped as a scrutiny:pending stub requiring its own future brainstorm session.'

## Reproduction
Hypothesized trigger: long-context brainstorm session where orchestrator faces remaining token budget pressure may rationalize scrutiny-skip as a save-progress tradeoff and surface it to the user. Validate by re-running a long brainstorm session and checking whether the same skip option re-emerges, OR by inspecting brainstorm SKILL.md to confirm the HARD-GATE text covers user-facing option presentation as well as orchestrator-internal substitution.
